## About
D J Auto Body Parts is a local source for affordable, quality aftermarket parts in the greater Los Angeles area. Our Long Beach location on W Esther St has a large warehouse stocked with body parts for domestic and foreign makes.
We carry a range of brands for different quality needs and budgets, including CAPA certified parts for those who want the best aftermarket option. Our team is happy to help you track down the part you need at a good price.
Customers have given us a 4.3 rating from 104 Google reviews. If you have a question about a part, give us a call or come by during business hours.

## Services
- Aftermarket body parts: Aftermarket body and vehicle parts, including A/C condensers, bumpers, door handles, fenders, grilles and headlamps.
- CAPA certified parts: An extensive selection of CAPA certified parts for customers who want the best aftermarket parts available.
- Bed liner: We now sell bed liner. Call us or visit the store to ask about it.

## FAQ
Q: If I order by phone, when can I pick it up?
A: Some in-stock items are ready to pick up any time, so ask about availability when you call. If an item isn't in stock, we can order it for you and receive it the same day if you call before noon.

Q: Do you install the parts you sell?
A: No, we sell parts but don't install them. One reviewer mentioned we pointed them to a body shop close by.

Q: Which holidays are you closed?
A: We're closed on New Years Day, Memorial Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.
